seo.metaTitle: Create Placeholder PNG - Free Size Label Image Maker
seo.metaDescription: Make a placeholder PNG with its dimensions printed in the center. Free, no upload, no signup - built in your browser as PNG, JPG, WebP or BMP.
seo.longDescription: Create a placeholder image fills a canvas of the size you choose with a background color and prints its own dimensions in the middle — a stand-in rectangle, for example 800 x 400, so a layout has something real to hold before the artwork exists and every image slot looks the right shape. The label is a bold sans face scaled to about 14 percent of the shorter side. Turn off Show text and you get a plain flat rectangle of the same size. The rectangle is drawn on your device, with nothing to upload.
facts: Drawn entirely in your browser: no upload, no server, no signup.
Any canvas size, with presets; the dimensions print in the center.
Show text off gives a plain flat rectangle.
On extremely lopsided canvases the label can exceed the width and is clipped.
For a transparent canvas with no lettering use the create empty PNG tool.
Free with no daily limit, no watermark and no account, also for commercial use.
howTo: No upload needed - the rectangle is drawn from the size and color values you set.
Set the Canvas size in pixels, or pick one of the presets.
Choose the Background color and the Text color.
Leave Show text on for the dimensions in the middle, or turn it off for a flat rectangle.
Download the placeholder as PNG, JPG, WebP or BMP from the Download button.

faq.q: Is this the same as creating an empty PNG?
faq.a: Not quite. Create empty PNG gives you a transparent or solid canvas with no lettering at all, which is what a layout or a compositor needs. This page adds the printed dimensions, so a human looking at the file can see what size it is supposed to be.

faq.q: Why is the label cut off on my image?
faq.a: The text scales with the shorter side of the canvas but never goes below a readable minimum, so on a very narrow or very short canvas the label ends up wider than the frame and is cropped. Make the canvas less extreme or turn Show text off.
Not directly - this tool fills the whole canvas with the background color you choose. For a transparent canvas with nothing in it, use the create empty PNG tool and set Opacity to 0.

faq.q: Is it free to use in a project?
faq.a: Yes. No signup, no upload, no watermark and no daily limit, the image is built in your browser, and the project is open source.
